Scenario TC-16/S23 — Transcript retention windows are configuration values (3.6)

Requirements it checks:
- U10: The transcript retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded, so they can be lengthened later.

Given: convex/lib/lifecycle.ts HOSPITAL_RETENTION (encounter 18 h, encounterArchive 48 h) and SNF_RETENTION (encounter 12 h, transcriptVisits 3)
When: Review where the windows are defined and how they would be lengthened under a hospital affiliation
Then: Each transcript window can be changed as runtime configuration without a code change and deploy, and the values match 3.6
Oracle: Pass only if each transcript window (Hospital encounter 18 h and the archive / yesterday window, Nursing Home 12 h and the visit count) is read from runtime configuration (an env var or a settings row) that can be changed without a code deploy, and its value matches 3.6. If Daniela says a named source constant is enough (Q14), the configuration half becomes a Pass and the values are still judged
